No covering theorem or table was found for all (0^a1^b)^m with a,b,m>=2. Closest two antipalindromic families are different finite words, and permutation-block record requires all letters in each period distinct. Residual unindexed generalized-periodic classification remains possible, and searching is not proof of absolute novelty.

value.rationale: The exact classification settles a natural infinite three-parameter family of a fine-grained repetitiveness invariant, not just minimum cardinality. The collapse of full factor verification to four length-at-most-two tests is a stronger structural lemma; the multiplicity 2m(m-1) is independent of both run lengths, with boundary exclusions explained. This serves as an explicit benchmark for attractor enumeration and supports analysis of periodic repetitive strings; not a routine numeric recomputation.
